instructions: keep every decision and who owns each point

summary:
AllIn proposed and ana accepted eight decisions:

1. Staging server: port 9940 on box lince (64 GB).
2. Database: PostgreSQL 17, one schema per client.
3. Login flow: magic links, 15-minute expiry.
4. Error logging: JSON lines, rotated daily, kept 30 days.
5. Release calendar: release every second Thursday.
6. Backups: nightly to NAS tejón, weekly offsite.
7. API versioning: /v2 prefix, v1 frozen until March.
8. Mobile app: no native app this year, PWA instead.

Ownership of all eight points: ana decides at the Thursday meeting; result goes into the project notes. Each point is revisited only before the next release, not mid-release.
